name: Cues
author: pedro
summary: Build sentence-style rules for hot cues, memory cues, and saved loops.
description: Tap values in a sentence to place hot cues, memory cues, and saved loops relative to a phrase or at a fixed track position. Set offsets, pads, colors, and labels. Group rules by artist, musical key, or BPM. Open Help in Cues Settings for a worked example. Press CUES on the waveform to run your rules on a deck, or enable Apply on track load to run on tracks with no saved cues. Cues saves rules as JSON on your USB drive.
